sources.name: D_ROAD-permit.txt
sources.text:
Road filming must not start until a signed road-closure order has been presented; amber barrier lamps must separate the filming lane while a named traffic steward remains at the gate.

The filing office cannot locate the closure order and cannot confirm whether the permit covers this access road because the referenced site map is missing.

An unsigned draft for Scene 602 claims filming may proceed without closure; nobody has verified that this draft supersedes the operations memo.
